instruction: Please configure VS Code to hide all "*.pyc" files from the file explorer.

metadata.explanation: Task requires hiding .pyc files in VS Code explorer. Uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify files.exclude setting contains '**/*.pyc': true. Similar to original task but with file pattern instead of folder pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: The new metric function check_json_settings (vscode.py:4-50) correctly implements deep nested dictionary checking via the _check_nested_dict helper (vscode.py:53-79)
For nested dictionaries, the metric verifies that all expected key-value pairs exist in the actual data, allowing additional keys to be present (vscode.py:41-45)
This correctly handles the case where files.exclude may already contain other patterns (e.g., '**/.git': true) - the metric will pass as long as '**/*.pyc': true is present
The getter get_vm_file correctly retrieves /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json from the VM
The expected value structure is correct: {'files.exclude': {'**/*.pyc': true}} properly specifies what the task requires
Coverage is complete: the evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires (hiding *.pyc files)
No postconfig needed as VS Code settings.json is persisted to disk
The evaluator can semantically and correctly verify that the instruction has been completed
